name: Derek Tran
bio: a Representative from California; born in Los Angeles County, Calif., December 22, 1980; B.S., Bentley University, Waltham, Mass., 2003; J.D., Glendale University, Glendale, Calif., 2013; United States Army; lawyer, private practice; business owner; elected as Democrat to the One Hundred Nineteenth Congress (January 3, 2025-present).
